instructions: Perform the first real read-only diagnostic of the local Click & Build repository.
Inspect repository identity, active branch, working-tree state, repository structure, and the project files available to the fixed read-only diagnostic operations.

Report which version/branch appears to contain the actual evolved gameplay and identify evidence relevant to the known customization issue (gender, eyes, hair not visibly applying) and baby posture/appearance progression, but do not modify or execute project code.
Do not create, modify, delete, move, commit, push, publish, install, or run arbitrary project commands. Preserve main and every gameplay file byte-for-byte.
success_criteria: Working-tree and relevant project structure reported
Useful read-only evidence for planning the next Click & Build diagnostic step
No cost and no arbitrary command execution
